Review Timeless?

Reviewers mostly see Timeless as a strong meeting assistant that reduces note-taking burden with useful transcripts, summaries, follow-ups, and searchable context across meetings. Repeated praise centers on bot-free Zoom recording, multilingual support, video clips and playback, proactive briefings, and integrations with tools like Monday.com, Slack, Notion, and Google Drive. Users say it helps remote teams and people with heavy meeting loads stay present and organized. The main complaints are uneven transcription accuracy, language and settings inconsistencies, limited calendar support, and missing team features like shared workspaces.
